verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches update control. On Antigravity, updates happen when you re-run the install command, not silently (gh-8). The Hermes install works from a git clone, which implies a checkout could be pinned (docs-53). Everything else ships through each harness's own install mechanism (docs-48), and dated release notes exist, but nothing documents version pinning, a lockfile, or team-wide update control. Missing for 10: documented version pinning, a lockfile or manifest for skills, team-level update gating, and evidence about auto-update behavior on Claude Code and other harnesses.
